title: Library Hours
content: The VIT-AP University Library is open from 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM on working days, and from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on Sundays, Mondays, and other holidays.

title: Library Location and Resources
aliases: how many books does library have
how do I borrow a book
content: The VIT-AP University Library is a centrally air-conditioned facility within the main VIT-AP campus in Amaravati (Inavolu, near Vijayawada), spread across approximately 1,500 sq. m with a seating capacity of 500. It holds more than 5,700 titles and 25,000+ volumes of text and reference books, plus print and e-journals, e-books, back volumes, and NPTEL videos. The library uses KOHA automation software with RFID self-service kiosks for issue and return. A separate VSL Library serves the School of Law, located in Administrative Block-II. Exact directions and campus maps are available at vitap.ac.in.
